summary: Short residential kerb where cars park, but homes sit 10-12 m away and it is steep.

best_section.where: North kerb of Marmion Parade at the uphill (west) end of the stretch

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 12 m from the kerb at 0 m and about 10 m by 13 m; apartments across the road at 19 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked on both sides; room for a van at the kerb.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs give 2P parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted.

sun_shade: Trees shade the western end; open to the south and east.
